scope: Source readiness for CPU construction and two-update real-batch preflight deployment per arm only.

attribution.statement: Requested Astra/max backend and effort are not independently attested. This is a fresh same-family source review, not cross-family acceptance.

summary: All 32 requested files were read directly. The reviewed implementation is correct for the stated CPU/two-update preflight source milestone. No blocking or nonblocking correctness defects were found. No patch is required by this source review.

source_checks.conclusion: Correct in source. The factory strictly loads the 1234-state official core after removing only the verified nonpersistent RoBERTa position_ids difference; installs the 37-state task/observation reader; replaces the exact dynamically expected 1072 G delta keys; and strictly loads the 10-state, 456102-parameter distribution geometry provider. G is a replacement delta, not 1072 additional states. All existing parameters are frozen before the 23-state readback is installed.

source_checks.area: Native semantic ordering, full text and candidate identity
source_checks.conclusion: Correct in source. Only the final semantic subhead is deferred when readback is installed. Native contrastive projections keep the original semantic Query; the Query Mask and box refiner keep the geometry Query. Both Mask paths finish before the refiner, then readback receives the original full cross-encoded text sequence with its padding mask, and the existing final semantic subhead runs once. No candidate is dropped or reordered and the existing bbs Box/Mask evaluator selects the same Query index.

Correct in source. Face order is x-, y-, z-, x+, y+, z+. Per-face width is 33 probabilities + offset + entropy + coarse face + final face + four axis-specific support moments + support mass + sign + size-floor flag = 44. Whole-support moments use the matching 96/99/102/105 offsets and mass slot 108 of the 109-dimensional provider. Hidden evidence is zeroed before the same encoder, while semantic Query, full text and face embeddings remain available. The arm flag does not change construction or random draws; both separate processes reset seed 2027 before the same factory. Zero output weights/bias preserve the original semantic Query at initialization.

source_checks.area: Native bbs reduction and final CE plus G gradient route
source_checks.conclusion: Correct in source. The diagnostic takes token softmax, binarizes only the root positive map, adds the unbinarized modifier/pronoun/relation map reductions, and subtracts the other-entity reduction, matching the reviewed native evaluator. It retains all 256 scores. The criterion visits proposal_, last_, then earlier heads, so matching[1] is the final native assignment. ScanRefer final CE weight is 0.5/7, and G replaces only the eos-weighted CE of detached-IoU-qualified unmatched slots. Regression/Mask Hungarian responsibility and contrastive positives are not extended. The caller isolates the actual last__loss_ce plus G gradients before and after the first update, then backpropagates the native total plus that correction. The obsolete frozen-geometry autograd helper is not called.

source_checks.area: Frozen eval behavior and memory restoration
source_checks.conclusion: Correct in source. model.eval() keeps the official/G/geometry modules, BatchNorm state and Dropout in eval; only the new readback is returned to train mode. The zero-residual and subsequent RNG-paired forwards compare boxes, provider evidence, native contrastive queries and both Mask paths exactly. The two-update loop admits only the readback's 23 trainable tensors and checks finite gradients with no upstream parameter gradients. It compares every persistent frozen state against initial, serializes the readback delta and AdamW state to BytesIO, reconstructs the complete model with strict=True, and compares all restored parameters, optimizer keys, moments, steps and parameter groups.

source_checks.area: Real-batch data, source and configuration interfaces
source_checks.conclusion: Correct in source for the requested preflight. The caller checks the fixed B8/seed2027/lr/weight-decay/clip contract, sealed model/dataset sources and weight identities before model loading. Dataset import precedes model import intentionally; direct module paths are checked and recorded. FitDataset assigns original row identities before the inherited parse, verifies all 36665 rows against the exact 29778/6887 scene partition, disables augmentation, preserves the same detected boxes/text/superpoints, and converts binary GT masks to bool only after checking their values. The reviewed criterion converts those masks to float where required. Fixture comparison and the point-order assertion precede the real first fit batch. Both arms perform two AdamW updates on that batch; there is no formal training loop.

source_checks.area: Source overlay, upload and GPU lifecycle
source_checks.conclusion: Correct in source within the cooperating-operator scope. The launcher checks the fresh review identities and existing bundle hashes, prior controller closure and an idle GPU, creates only the fixed new preflight root, uploads exact bytes using exclusive creation and readback comparison, and starts the controller under the existing flock GPU lock. Shell arguments and paths are quoted; subprocess worker arguments are passed as a list. The sealer checks the pinned parent manifest and its source files, copies that parent into the owned root, applies only the two reviewed model overrides, and then supplies source_port_sha256 to the two templates. Its absence from unsealed templates is intentional. The controller runs CPU then two-update preflight sequentially for each arm, checks receipts and stops on nonzero worker exit. The launcher records LAUNCHED_NOT_COMPLETED; the shell records controller.exit and the GPU lock is released on exit. No new model-weight file is saved by the preflight.

independent_ast_check.reason: The local Python launcher failed before the inspection program began with 'No pyvenv.cfg file'. No project source or model was executed; the supplied prior AST marker was not treated as a fresh AST result.

runtime_dependencies_not_executed: The sealed parent source_port and inherited model/backbone/decoder/import dependencies must match the pinned runtime; the reviewed local inherited interface snapshots were read, but the remote environment was not accessed.
env_spec.json must provide env (including PYTHONPATH), resource_limits.gpu_lock and weight_dirs.scanrefer.path/sha256, with the expected canonical env identity.

The runtime YAML must provide the actual backbone model configuration, DATA_PROCESSOR and DATA_CONFIG.POINT_CLOUD_RANGE; the inherited DataProcessor is required to preserve the checked 8x50000x6 point order.

The input manifest must provide the sealed dataset source, split_protocol, split_salt, data_root and superpoint_files.train. The train fixture receipt and task-observation interface receipt must meet the caller's explicit fields and assertions.

The official payload must contain its real config/model; the G payload must contain the exact 1072 state_delta keys; the geometry payload must contain the matching ten states and step=3723, head_only, boundary_mode, support_arm, use_whole_range and boundary_loss_weight metadata.

Actual CPU construction, package/import compatibility, CUDA behavior, numerical equality, nonzero/finite real gradients, memory restoration, peak memory and timing remain to be established by the authored preflight.
